column3: Whale 3/1 is still behind Peacock and Squirrel. The engine has already replaced Whale with the swallowed Worm 29/40.
Real player has Hedgehog 9/7 with Blowfish 31/1 behind it. The engine retains only Hedgehog 9/7. Both sides show the opposing Wolverine 1/1.
Real player has Hedgehog 9/7 and Blowfish 28/1 against Wolverine 1/1. The engine has lost the Blowfish before normal combat begins.
Real still has Blowfish 24/1 facing Wolverine 1/1 after the first exchange. The engine has already eliminated the player side.
Real opponent Wolverine is 10/13 and Shark 13/16. Engine has Wolverine 10/19 and Shark 13/10. Equal starting boards do not distinguish a random target from a trigger-order difference here.
Real opponent still has Snake 8/1 between Bison 34/31 and Mammoth 12/1. The engine has no Snake and Mammoth is 12/8. The real player Blowfish is 7/10 against the engine’s 7/9.
The real opponent front has two 8/8 Zombie Flies, then a 10/6 Bus. The engine has one 8/8 Zombie Fly, then Bus and Scorpion. A Bee remains at the real back.
Real retains Skunk 6/9 behind Peacock 15/2. The engine has no player Skunk and a 9/6 Peacock. Real Shark is 12/4 versus the native 16/16.
After the rear Cat faints, the real Blowfish has 22/13 and Tiger 23/28; the engine has Blowfish 22/32 and Tiger 23/9. This is already different before Swan attacks. See source frame 0015.
The real front is a 34/34 Parrot followed by Snake and Tiger. The engine still has an 11/7 Boar in front of its 26/30 Parrot.
The real surviving front Turkey is 14/6 and the Cat is 8/9. The engine has Turkey 14/11 and Cat 8/4; the opposing 5/2 Whale, 8/3 Snake, 6/4 Tiger and 15/22 Shark remain in the same order.
Real Wolverine is 11/5 against native 11/8. On the opposing side the real Flamingo is 23/16 and Blowfish 16/12, versus 23/10 and 16/18 in the engine. The targeted pets already differ.
Real front is a 4/4 Zombie Fly followed by 9/2 Chick and 13/1 Snake. Engine front is two 9/2 Chicks followed by Tiger. The real opposing Skunk is still present.
The real opponent has a 4/4 Deer in front of Blowfish and Cow. The engine has a 10/6 Bus and an 8/10 Snake in front of those two. The player board agrees.
Real Worm, Shark and Whale have 10, 16 and 1 HP. Engine has 1, 25 and 4 HP. The real opposing Blowfish is also one HP higher.
The client has Deer 10/15, Leopard 18/1 and Cat 5/1. The engine has Whale 7/5 and Leopard 18/1; opponents agree.

Before normal combat the real opposing Mammoth is 1/1, Elephant 21/13, Blowfish 12/17 and Shark 1/1. Engine values for the same four are 13/5, 15/4, 1/1 and 12/12. This fight contains a Leopard, so target choice is a competing explanation.
Real Rat 19/18, Giraffe 8/1 and Wolverine 8/12 differ from native 19/15, 8/7 and 8/9. The opposing Elephant, Blowfish, Tiger and Peacock also have different HP.
Real starts the first attack with Camel 12/27, Rabbit 3/6 and Skunk 3/5. The engine still has an additional 7/12 Cat, its Camel is 12/22 and its Skunk is 3/1.
Real player has Swan 12/8 at the back, and Blowfish 15/25. Native retains Cat 10/7 and has Blowfish 15/13. Snipe targets and HP already differ before the first exchange.

The round-one green pet is a Zombie Fly, matching native. After round two it is gone and the two boards still agree. After round three the real Ox/Snake/Fly are 22/21, 12/12, 8/12 versus native 22/24, 12/15, 8/15. Real Cat 8/14 and Wolverine 8/18 are native 8/19 and 8/13. See frame 0026.
The client still shows Hedgehog 6/1, Parrot 5/1 and Blowfish 13/9. The engine has already eliminated the player side. Real Tiger survives between Blowfish and Wolverine.
The real Dragon has 6/10, versus 6/4 in the engine. The opposing Blowfish shows 28/36 versus 28/35. Both teams still have five pets; the stats diverge before a normal attack.
Real Badger is 33/48 and the player Snake is gone. Engine has Badger 33/38 with Snake 11/10 still behind it. The real front opposing Peacock is 34/7 versus native 28/12.
Real retains two player Skunks, the extra one at 4/1 directly behind Badger. Native has one Skunk. The opponent lineup agrees at this boundary.

The crossed-out Cow in the start image is already dying. The living start teams agree. After the first exchange the real rear Squirrel 9/4 and front enemy Crocodile 31/1 remain, while native has lost both.
Real opposing middle is Bus 10/6 and Tiger 6/4; the engine still has a 4/4 Mushroom Deer and no Tiger. Real Cat/Dog HP is 6/5 versus native 1/10.
Real rear Dodo is 17/11 behind Whale and Bus. The engine has Dodo 17/13. This is a two-HP difference at the first attack.
The real player’s two Blowfish are 10/18 and 3/6. The engine has 10/21 and 3/3. The real opponent Elephant and Snail also differ by one HP. These start-of-battle shots can choose different targets.

The first Elephant/Blowfish damage chain leaves only a player Blowfish 8/15. Native also keeps Elephant 6/3 and its Blowfish is 8/9. On the real opponent Deer 2/2 is still a Deer; native has a Bus. Frame 0024 is after the crossed-out pets are removed.

Rounds one and two agree: the green 1/1 is Zombie Cricket. On round three the front Spider summons Elephant 2/2 in the client versus Rabbit 2/2 in the engine, with the Dog at 12/10 in both. This isolates a random species choice.

The player Rat faints and a 1/1 Dirty Rat appears on the opposing side. The real opposing Dog stays 9/7, its starting stats, while native Dog increases to 11/8. The other six surviving pets at this point agree.

Both 6/2 summons in round two are Rams. In round four the player Rat gives the opponent a Dirty Rat. In front of three Horses the real Dirty Rat is still 1/1; the engine gives it 5/1. The existing Horses agree.

The same five player pets are present, but the real order is Cat, Bus, Whale, Fly, Zombie Fly. The engine puts Zombie Fly directly behind Cat, ahead of Bus. Enemy order and stats agree. This is a placement difference before any normal attack.
Real front Crab is 6/7 versus native 6/8. The remaining player pets (Turtle, Peacock, Fish, Otter) and opponent formation agree in this frame.

Both R​ams are 4/2 and the Horse is 4/4. The real Dirty Rat between the Rams and Horse is 1/1; native gives it 3/1. The player board is identical. This repeats the gifted-Rat/Horse discrepancy with a level-two Horse.

The client has two 1/1 Dirty Rats in front of Penguin and Turkey. The engine has the same lineup but buffs both Dirty Rats to 4/2. Opposing Skunk is 8/21 in both. This is the Turkey version of the gifted-Rat discrepancy.

The real Crab and Rabbit start combat at 4/10 and 2/1. The engine has 4/6 and 2/5. The crossed-out rear pet is already dying and should not be counted as an extra survivor. Two enemy Dolphins are on this board.
The real opponent Rat/Camel are 9/11 and 5/5. The engine assigns them 7/9 and 7/7. Both sides have the same pet ordering.
The opponent has a 4/4 Elephant between Pig and Whale; native has a 4/4 Dodo there. The remaining visible pets and stats agree. The species choice is already different at start.

The real front is Cricket 1/3; the first Duck has already fainted. Engine retains front Duck 2/1 with Cricket behind it. The rear real Pigeon is 4/3 versus native 4/2. Two enemy Mosquitoes can choose different targets.
Real opponent includes Bus 8/4 between Parrot and Ox. The engine begins attacking with only Deer, Parrot, Ox and Turkey. Real and native player front Deer and Dolphin agree.

The settled real Dolphin is 8/4 versus native 8/7. After the two Camels are removed the opposing real Bison, Ant and Blowfish are 11/10, 9/7, 9/13 rather than 11/11, 9/6, 10/16. Frame 0014 shows the settled start board.

The crossed-out pet at the back of the start frame is not living. Through exchange two both living boards agree. The third hit takes the real Bison from 16 HP to 13 and leaves Skunk 3/2 alive; native retains Bison 12/16 and removes Skunk. The crossed-out Blowfish is not an extra surviving opponent.

The round-one opponent is visibly a Badger, matching the engine. In round two the real player still has Dodo 8/2 in front and a rear Spider 2/2. Native has lost Dodo and its rear Spider is 4/4. Ant’s stat target differs.
Dirty Rat 1/1 appears opposite the Camel. The real Dog remains 11/8; native Dog becomes 13/9. The two Flamingos, Spider, and player board agree.
Real Dodo is gone, Peacock is 9/8 and Ox is 2/4 with Melon. Native still has Dodo 5/4, Peacock 12/5 and Ox 1/4. On the other side real Camel/Blowfish are 8/9 and 5/4 versus native 8/6 and 6/9.

The real defender begins the next exchange with Deer 2/2 and no Ant; native still has a 5/2 Ant ahead of Deer. The real Swan is 14/9 versus native 14/14, and the real opposing Dog is 9/8 versus native 7/6. The 6/7 pet on the player board is a Snail.
